name: Parekh Integrated Services Pvt. Ltd. (PISPL)
summary: PISPL commits to responsible, ethical, and sustainable procurement across its operations, with a strong emphasis on green procurement, supplier ESG performance, and supply chain accountability. The policy embeds environmental and social criteria into sourcing, vendor selection, and renovation activities to reduce impact and improve sustainability outcomes.

declaration.preface: Parekh Integrated Services Pvt. Ltd. (PISPL) is committed to conducting its logistics, warehousing, and supply chain operations in an environmentally responsible and sustainable manner. The Company recognizes its responsibility to minimize environmental impacts, conserve natural resources, and contribute to climate change mitigation through continuous improvement in environmental performance. PISPL integrates sustainability into its operations through energy efficiency, renewable energy adoption, responsible resource use, waste reduction, and green building practices.
declaration.declaration: The purpose of this Environmental Policy is to establish a structured framework for managing environmental impacts associated with the operations of Parekh Integrated Services Pvt. Ltd. (PISPL). This policy aims to ensure that environmental considerations are integrated into business decision-making, operational activities, and long-term strategic planning. It defines the Company’s commitment to regulatory compliance, resource efficiency, pollution prevention, and continuous improvement in environmental performance.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all PISPL operations, including warehouses, transportation, and office locations across all national and international locations. It covers all permanent, temporary, and contract employees across all functions, as well as all internal and external stakeholders associated with the PISPL Group, whether directly or indirectly.

Air Quality Management: We strive to adopt cleaner fuels and environmentally friendly technologies by promoting low-emission alternatives and energy-efficient systems.

Control and minimize emissions of VOCs, SOx, and NOx from warehouse operations by ensuring proper maintenance of diesel-operated equipment, generators, and vehicles, and by adopting cleaner fuel alternatives where feasible.

Prevent air contamination from storage and handling activities involving volatile substances (VOCs) by ensuring proper sealing, labelling, and controlled storage of chemicals, fuels, or other emission-prone materials.
We will maintain all vehicles and equipment regularly to ensure reduced emissions through scheduled inspections and preventive maintenance.
We commit to minimizing air emissions from our transportation and warehouse operations by improving route efficiency and reducing fuel consumption.
We strive to improve indoor air quality across all facilities through proper ventilation, monitoring, and maintenance systems.
Customer Health & Safety: We commit to ensuring the safety and integrity of all customer products handled within our operations by implementing quality control measures and secure handling practices.
We will ensure maintain high standards of hygiene and safety in all warehouse environments through regular cleaning, inspections, and adherence to safety protocols.
We will implement robust systems for incident reporting and corrective action by establishing clear reporting procedures and timely resolution mechanisms.
We strive to maintain strict temperature control for sensitive products through continuous monitoring and calibrated storage systems.
Climate and Energy Efficiency: We commit to progressively lowering energy consumption across all our facilities by adopting efficient technologies and responsible operational practices.
We strive to embed energy conservation into daily operations through employee awareness and engagement.
Increase the use of renewable energy within warehouse operations by expanding existing rooftop solar infrastructure and optimizing its utilization to reduce dependence on conventional energy sources.
We are committed to monitoring and managing greenhouse gas emissions in a structured and transparent manner.
We will prioritize procurement of energy-efficient equipment across all facilities by selecting high-efficiency and low-energy consumption alternatives.
Resource and Waste Optimization: We commit to optimizing material usage and minimizing waste generation across operations by improving material planning and reducing excess consumption.
We will promote recycling, reuse, and responsible disposal practices by implementing structured waste management programs and awareness initiatives.
We strive to ensure safe handling and storage of all chemicals through proper labelling, training, and adherence to safety protocols.
We will implement waste segregation at source across all facilities by providing designated bins and clear segregation guidelines.
Water Stewardship: We commit to using water responsibly and reducing consumption across all operations by implementing efficient usage practices and conservation measures.

Strengthen water conservation practices within warehouse operations by maintaining and optimizing the existing rainwater harvesting system, and implementing reuse mechanisms supported by appropriate infrastructure and monitoring systems.
We aim to regularly monitor water consumption and identify improvement opportunities through periodic tracking and analysis.
We will promote reuse and recycling of water wherever operationally feasible by implementing treatment and reuse systems.

policy.monitoring: PISPL commits to continuously improving its environmental and sustainability performance by enhancing efficiency in energy, water, waste, emissions, and safety management. The Company will adopt best practices, promote employee awareness, and integrate learnings from audits and feedback to drive ongoing improvements.
policy.reviewMechanism: PISPL will annually or as per requirement review this policy and its targets to ensure effectiveness and alignment with business and regulatory requirements. The review will be conducted by the ESG / Sustainability Head. The Company will update actions based on review findings, ensure closure of corrective actions, and maintain proper documentation for audit purposes.
